title: Currently on Build 35 after two weeks...
author: DivideBYZero69
selftext:
Completely free, no account needed. 

Built with Claude Code Opus 5.5, Three.js & Cloudflare Workers, I wanted a true peer to peer & local Multiplayer Real Time Strategy game, but ended up making it to include full WAN compatibility too.  Biggest distance in a MP game has been Europe to South America with no hiccups.  

It's a fully fledged RTS, with many civs, maps, sizes and all the usual extras you'd expect.  The update rate is so fast because the pipeline runs seamlessly from claude to Github to Cloudflare automatically, and deploys are usually ready in around 45 seconds.  

  
 Good use of Workers & Durable Objects for the Server components. 

  
Enjoy! And please leave test notes here, too!

  
[https://fourcrowns.qrsure.app](https://fourcrowns.qrsure.app)
